notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Improvements:

Stage introduction sequence can now be skipped
Character selection screen flow improved


Fixes:

Fixes slot highlight not stopping after completion if another player was still holding the same object
Fixes player disconnect issue during tutorials
Fixes table lamp light sector in 4-2
Fixes plant vase having a collider on the plant portion of the sprite
Removes misplaced bush in 2-3
Button prompts properly update with connected controller type
Esperanto localization fixes
Minor wording adjustments on tutorials
Fixes to achievement descriptions
